title: Act: Add Exporter, Export format and ErrNotFrozen
summary: Create export.go with the documented export
description: New file export.go implementing the Exporter over ExportSource.
acceptance_criteria: Export returns only frozen contributions in stable order

steps.symbol: new: package doc, ExportSource, Export, ExportEntry, ErrNotFrozen
steps.action: Create the file with a package-level doc comment describing the JSON format and that only snapshot-frozen contributions are exported; declare ExportSource interface, Export and ExportEntry structs with the json tags and ErrNotFrozen.

Add type Exporter{Source ExportSource} and method Export(ctx, worldID, roundID) (Export, error): call FrozenIDs (return ErrNotFrozen if frozen=false), call ListByRound, keep only contributions whose ID is in the frozen set, convert to ExportEntry with CreatedAt.UTC(), initialise Contributions to an empty non-nil slice, set Version 1.
steps.code: func (e Exporter) Export(ctx context.Context, worldID, roundID string) (Export, error)
steps.expected: Returns Export with Contributions [] when none are frozen
